title: Supreme Court Bench
purpose: Justice sector card and judiciary-vertical surfaces.
story: The high bench of a supreme court at rest — the seat of final judgement, empty and waiting beneath its columns.
environment: A solemn courtroom, a long raised bench facing rows of counsel tables across a marble floor.
architecture: Classical justice interior — fluted columns flanking the bench, a deep entablature, a recessed apse dissolving into shadow.
composition: The raised bench centred and symmetrical, columns framing the void above it, the polished floor leading the eye inward.
negativeExtra: any inscriptions on the bench or walls
continuityNotes: Matches the set's near-black grade, single warm source, and brass-on-black palette established in scene-01.
